text.tspan: Create a new branch in your fork
(1) Edit files in your branch, (2) commit
Open Pull Request against staging main
Preview guidance (may take a few minutes, 404 = wait and refresh)
Instructions: React with thumbs-up when ready for review
GitHub Actions runs PR Preview Build workflow
Preview URL appears in bot comment
Check preview at URL from bot comment
Links and images load as expected
7. Code Review and Merge to Staging
After approval, merge PR into staging main
Run Promote to Prod workflow in Actions tab
Builds with production baseURL and writes CNAME
GitHub Pages deploys from site branch
This allows the maintainer to know that the contributor is happy with
